description: A line carrying both a reverse and a forward direction word is reported rather than resolved in silence, and a reverse reference outside the plan states the direction it actually read (Issue #51).

warning_details_include: #40 states both a forward and a reverse direction about #41 on one line
the planner read it as "#40 depends on #41"
#42 blocks #43, which is not in this plan (#43 would depend on #42)

40:41: both a forward and a reverse direction word
